title: Secret of the Turtle Shell
next_chapter_hook: A familiar call echoed from the depths of the turtle shell, a voice belonging to one he thought he had lost forever—Chen Nian. The key of fate and the medium to break the局 have finally intertwined into a choice Chen Ji cannot avoid.

text.content:
Black mist at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds coiled like a living creature. The moment Chen Ji stepped inside, the Tianji Record suddenly burned hot. The golden patterns on the fragment went haywire, as if sensing something it resonated with. He steadied his mind, his gaze piercing through layers of illusion, and saw a massive turtle shell standing in the center of the ruins.

The turtle shell stood about three zhang high, completely ink-black, yet its surface rippled with star-like lights, as if sealing an entire night sky. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—he had seen it in countless prophecy fragments, yet never imagined it to be so... complete.

dialogue.content: 「You've finally come.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted out from the Tianji Record, carrying a solemnity Chen Ji had never heard before. 「This turtle shell was forged by hand by the original master of the Tianji Record. It's not an ordinary divine artifact—it is the key to connect with the Heavenly Realm, and also the greatest hidden move laid by the chess players across generations.」

text.content:
Chen Ji did not rush forward. Instead, he walked slowly around the turtle shell, observing the ancient formation runes on the ground. These runes spiraled inward, finally converging at the exact center beneath the turtle shell—where there was a fist-sized indentation that... matched his heart pulse acupoint perfectly.

He stopped, brow furrowed.

「Chess players across generations?」 Chen Ji repeated quietly. 「The Tianji Record has more than one generation of inheritors?」

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized from the book's pages, and a trace of bitterness appeared on his blurred features: 「It's not just more than one generation. Do you think the Eye of Heavenly Mandate wipes out all seers for no reason? Because every generation of chess players has the potential to break free from its control.」

dialogue.content: 「This turtle shell is a transboundary artifact forged by the First Chess Player to oppose the Eye of Heavenly Mandate.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed through the vast forbidden grounds. 「It contains the coordinates to the Heavenly Realm, but it's also a double-edged sword—whoever activates it can enter the Heavenly Realm; but if used improperly, they will be completely locked onto by the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, becoming its puppet.」

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his own palm. The Tianji Record's fragment was faintly scalding, golden patterns writhing across his skin like living things. Suddenly, he understood.

「So the Tianji Record chose me, not because of some exceptional talent—」 he said slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm. 「But because there's some connection between my bloodline and this turtle shell?」

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, and his blurred remnant soul trembled slightly.

「You are indeed perceptive.」 He sighed. 「Your ancestor was not an ordinary member of the Chen clan. He was the disciple of the First Chess Player, and also the blood sacrifice when the turtle shell was forged. In your blood flows the key to open the gate to the Heavenly Realm.」

Chen Ji closed his eyes, countless images flashing through his mind at lightning speed. The scene of being tested for bloodline by elders as a child, the details of being specially permitted to access forbidden texts when entering the Tianqing Sect, even the moment when the incomplete Tianji Record had fallen into his hands—all these seemingly coincidental opportunities now pointed to a chilling truth.

From the very beginning, he had been manipulated by an invisible hand.

「Heh.」 Chen Ji suddenly let out a soft laugh, the smile ice-cold and bone-chilling. 「What an ultimate chess player. To have orchestrated for eons just to have me activate this turtle shell—what does he actually want?」

dialogue.content:
「He doesn't want anything.」 Mo Xiansheng's answer was unexpected. 「Or rather, his 'wanting' has long transcended good and evil, right and wrong. When the First Chess Player forged the turtle shell, his purpose was to tear apart the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's blockade and open a path to heaven for mortals. But he failed—under the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's backlash, his divine soul was split in two. Half became the Tianji Record, and the other half... became the power dormant within your blood.」

He paused, his voice becoming unusually low: 「The Ultimate Chess Player chose you because the half within you is the key to opposing the Eye of Heavenly Mandate. But the cruel irony is—once you fully activate it, you will no longer be 'yourself'. You will become the vessel for the First Chess Player's resurrection.」

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, golden patterns from the Tianji Record swirling rapidly in the depths of his pupils. He saw it—in a fragment of the future, he stood atop the turtle shell, surrounded by countless chains, their other ends connected to an invisible giant eye deep within the heavens.

And his body was growing translucent, piece by piece, being devoured by some older, vaster will.

「So this turtle shell, this bloodline, this entire chess game—」 Chen Ji's voice was low as an abyss. 「It's all just to have the First Chess Player, dead for ten thousand years, resurrect using my body?」

Mo Xiansheng did not answer, but that silence itself was the cruelest answer.

text.content:
Chen Ji pressed his palm into the indentation without hesitation. The scalding bloodline power and the turtle shell produced a violent resonance. In an instant, he felt himself standing in chaos, facing a figure with similar features but far more ancient—that was the remnant soul of the First Chess Player.

「Your body, I'll take it.」 The ancient voice was cold and majestic.

Chen Ji laughed instead, that smile carrying a chilling composure: 「Senior, you wish to resurrect using my body after ten thousand years, but haven't you asked whether I'm willing?」

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly withdrew his palm. The Tianji Record's fragment spun rapidly in his palm, golden light condensing into a destructive beam. There was not a hint of hesitation in his eyes—if this turtle shell was the fetter binding his fate, then he would shatter it completely.

「If fate wishes to imprison me, then let fate itself be destroyed.」

The beam fired, but at the moment it touched the turtle shell, it was deflected by an invisible barrier. At the same time, the entire forbidden grounds began to shake violently. Ancient formation runes appeared densely across the ground—the self-destruction formation.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out sharply: 「Fool! The turtle shell is blood-linked to this forbidden grounds. If you forcibly destroy it, you will be annihilating yourself along with the entire entrance to the Heavenly Realm!」

text.content:
Chen Ji sat cross-legged, pressing both hands onto the Tianji Record and the Turtle Shell simultaneously. His breathing gradually became long and slow, the power of his bloodline flowing like countless tiny streams into the ancient formation runes within the Turtle Shell.

Tearing agony surged from the depths of his soul—two wills warring within his body. The residual soul of the first-generation chess master howled furiously: "You madman! Such fusion will destroy both your body and spirit!"

Chen Ji gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, yet forced out words: "Senior... your chess game is no longer in your control. From now on, this Turtle Shell—belongs to the Chen family."

Three completely different forces converged and collided within the Forbidden Grounds. Chen Ji felt as if he were being torn into countless fragments, yet at the edge of each fragment, he saw the same image—

A blurry figure stood atop the Turtle Shell, surrounded by golden patterns identical to his own. That figure turned its head, regarding him with a gaze both almost benevolent and utterly cold.

"You are more interesting than I anticipated." The voice came as if from the nine heavens, "Since you refuse to be a vessel, I shall give you a chance—prove you are worthy of being kept."

Before the words even faded, a blinding light suddenly blazed from deep within the Turtle Shell, and a familiar voice that made Chen Ji's soul tremble emerged—

"Brother... is that you?"

dialogue.content:
The voice was soft and weak, as if struggling to reach him from an endless abyss. Chen Ji froze, and for the first time, an undisguised shock appeared on his always cold, composed face.

"Niannian...?"

Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly tensed: "Impossible! When Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect, I witnessed her being refined into a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—her divine soul should have merged with the Turtle Shell long ago—wait, could it be that..."

text.content:
Golden light blazed in Chen Ji's pupils as the Tianji Record ran wildly. He saw it—within that radiance, a young girl with features similar to his own lay curled in chaos, surrounded by countless golden chains. Her eyes were shut tight, her face pale as paper, yet she kept calling his name.

Chen Nian.

His sister, missing for years, whom he had believed dead.

She had been here all along—trapped within the Turtle Shell, becoming the lock key connecting the heavens and mortal realm. And the reason his bloodline power could be sensed by the Turtle Shell was because they shared the same origin.

Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, and for the first time, actual flames of fury burned in those always cold eyes.

dialogue.content:
Golden chains began to shatter under the impact of Chen Ji's bloodline power, and densely packed cracks appeared on the Turtle Shell's surface. The girl's voice suddenly became clear: "Brother, don't! Once you forcibly destroy the Lock Key, the Heavenly Eye will immediately lock onto your location—they've been waiting for me to expose myself!"

Chen Ji's body trembled, yet his hands showed no sign of stopping: "So what? If saving you means facing the entire heavens, then I shall trample this heaven."

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He closed his eyes, slowly projecting his divine sense into that radiance. In an instant, countless pieces of information flooded his mind—everything Chen Nian had gathered during the years she was trapped here.

"Brother, I'm fine." Chen Nian's voice became clear and firm, "These chains appear to imprison me, but they are also helping me resist the Heavenly Eye's direct erosion. As long as you don't touch them, I'm safe for now."

"But—" her tone suddenly turned heavy, "The Ultimate Chess Master's plan goes far beyond this. He intends to use your hand to simultaneously activate both the Turtle Shell and the Lock Key. Once you do, both of us will become his puppets."

Chen Ji silently digested this information, his mind racing. The Ultimate Chess Master's scheme was even more profound than he had imagined—not only did he intend to use Chen Ji to resurrect the first-generation chess master, but he also planned to lock Chen Nian permanently at the entrance to the heavenly realm as a Lock Key. This chess game had from the very beginning regarded the siblings as two mere pieces.

But when had Chen Ji ever been willing to be another's piece?

"Niannian," he spoke, his voice low and dangerous, "Tell me, how can we destroy these chains without triggering the trap?"

Chen Nian's voice carried a hint of surprise, then warmth: "Brother, you are indeed that infallible Chen Ji. After three years of observation, I discovered the chains' weakness lies at their connection points with the Turtle Shell—but to sever those connections, two forces must strike simultaneously from both inside and outside."

"Inside is you, outside is me." Chen Ji immediately understood her meaning, "But I'm outside the Turtle Shell now. To transmit power inward, I must use the Tianji Record as a medium—and the Tianji Record itself is the other half of the first-generation chess master."

"So the key lies in whether you can control that portion of will within the Tianji Record." Chen Nian's voice turned urgent, "Brother, I have a feeling—even though the Ultimate Chess Master has been scheming for ten thousand years, he overlooked one thing."

Chen Ji's brow slightly raised: "What?"

"He doesn't know you have already fused with the Tianji Record's fragments." Chen Nian's voice carried a trace of excitement, "Those fragments were not left by the Ultimate Chess Master, but were deliberately scattered by the first-generation chess master before his fall—he was leaving future generations a chance to turn the tables!"

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's residual soul trembled violently at this moment, his voice carrying undisguised excitement for the first time: "So that's it... so the first-generation chess master was scheming from the very beginning! He divided the Tianji Record into two halves—one to select successors, the other deliberately scattered across the mortal realm, waiting for someone truly worthy to reunite them—"

He abruptly turned to Chen Ji, a hint of reverence appearing on his blurry features: "You are not merely fusing with the Turtle Shell, you are completing the Tianji Record! When all the fragments unite as one, the first-generation chess master's will will completely dissipate, and the one who truly controls the Tianji Record—will be only you!"

text.content:
Chen Ji felt that power awakening within him. The fragments of the Tianji Record flowed and gathered within his bloodline, each one establishing a deeper connection with him. He could clearly sense that the will contained within those fragments was not trying to devour him, but waiting—waiting for an heir strong and resolute enough.

He slowly opened his eyes, gazing at the cracked Turtle Shell, at that blurry yet familiar figure deep within.

"Niannian, wait for me." His voice was terrifyingly calm, "This time, I will not let anyone else control our fate."

Deep within the Turtle Shell, Chen Nian's tightly shut eyes finally opened a crack, tears falling silently.

Just then, a deafening roar erupted above the Forbidden Grounds. A massive rift tore through the void, and an enormous eye, condensed from pure golden light, peered out from the depths of the rift, gazing down at these ruins with indifference.

It was the Heavenly Eye.

It had been alerted.

Chen Ji raised his head to face that giant eye directly, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips. He raised his right hand, and the final fragment of the Tianji Record appeared in his palm, ancient and majestic energy flowing within the golden light.

"Perfect timing." His voice echoed through the Forbidden Grounds, "The Ultimate Chess Master's scheme, the Heavenly Eye's surveillance—today, let me, Chen Ji, personally overturn this chessboard!"

Deep within the Turtle Shell, Chen Nian's figure suddenly blazed with blinding light. She formed seals with both hands, beginning to dismantle the chains binding her from within. With forces striking from both inside and outside, the first crack finally appeared in the fetters of fate.
